title: The Obsidian Razor Sword
hook: An oak club lined with volcanic glass so sharp it beheaded a horse.

scenes.text: The primary close-quarters weapon of elite Aztec warriors was the 'macuahuitl': a flat hardwood club edged with volcanic glass.

scenes.text: Crafted from dense mountain oak, grooves along both sides held rows of razor-sharp prismatic blades flaked from black volcanic obsidian.
